cause: Authority checks compared delimiter text only after universal newline and Unicode-wide line normalization had discarded the original physical boundary.
prevention: Read Markdown with untranslated newlines, accept only LF or CRLF, reject lone CR and Unicode-wide separators, and exercise source, packaged, work-close, and Stop consumers.
summary: A Unicode-wide line splitter erased noncanonical separators around frontmatter markers and let repeated-failure prevention watches gain authority.
title: Preserve physical accepted-watch line boundaries
